stories.title: Labour wins Holborn & St Pancras by-election
stories.details: Labour candidate Sagal Abdi-Wali won the by-election in Sir Keir Starmer's former seat with 12,292 votes. She defeated Green Party leader Zack Polanski, who finished second, in a contest that saw the Greens claim a significant increase in their vote share.

stories.title: Kemi Badenoch's inheritance tax pledge
stories.details: Tax experts and commentators have warned that Kemi Badenoch's proposal to exempt family homes from inheritance tax could distort the housing market. Critics suggest it may encourage elderly homeowners to upsize assets rather than downsize, failing to free up housing space.

stories.title: Government review on autism and ADHD
stories.details: A government review has concluded that the surge in autism and ADHD diagnoses is at a 'tipping point.' The report warns that current system failures risk causing lifelong harm to children due to inadequate care and support.

stories.title: Bank of England governor on public finances
stories.details: The governor of the Bank of England has urged the government to take stronger action to repair public finances. This call comes amid significant volatility and a rout in global bond markets.

stories.title: RTÉ funding and reform
stories.details: RTÉ is likely to recover €20 million lost in the 2027 budget, provided it demonstrates that internal reforms are on track. The Taoiseach and Tánaiste’s offices have reportedly intervened ahead of a meeting with the broadcaster's leadership.

stories.title: Samsung forecasts record $80B profit
stories.details: Samsung expects to report a record-breaking quarterly operating profit of $80 billion. The surge is driven by high global demand for memory chips, including DRAM and NAND flash, fueled by the ongoing AI boom.

stories.title: OpenAI launches GPT-6
stories.details: OpenAI has released GPT-6 to all ChatGPT users, featuring an 'Intelligent UI' that generates interactive diagrams and side-by-side comparisons. The model also includes improved web search capabilities and enhanced safety training.

stories.title: Goldman Sachs bonus pool
stories.details: Top executives at Goldman Sachs are set to share a bonus pool worth up to $500 million. This announcement follows a period of strong performance for the banking giant.

stories.title: Anthropic releases Haiku 5.5
stories.details: Anthropic has launched Claude Haiku 5.5, a low-cost, high-speed AI model. The new version significantly reduces input and output token costs while introducing new reasoning capabilities.

stories.title: Google Cloud unveils Gemini work agent
stories.details: Google Cloud has introduced the Gemini agent, a centralized assistant designed for enterprise workflows. The agent can handle coding, content creation, and data analysis by integrating with existing business systems.

stories.title: Researcher warns of AI threat to crypto
stories.details: Ethereum researcher Justin Drake has warned that AI advancements could soon crack the ECDSA cryptography protecting crypto wallets. He has urged users to migrate funds to more secure addresses before quantum computing threats materialize.

stories.title: Manchester City financial scandal
stories.details: Manchester City is facing intense scrutiny after being found guilty of over 100 breaches of Premier League financial regulations. The club, owned by Sheikh Mansour, is accused of using sham sponsorship contracts to inflate income and bypass spending rules.

stories.title: Premier League weekend outlook
stories.details: As the Premier League continues, focus remains on the fallout from the Manchester City charges. Managers and players, including Enzo Maresca and Erling Haaland, have urged the club to stay positive despite the ongoing investigation.

stories.title: Leinster Rugby returns to Laya Arena
stories.details: Leinster Rugby is set to host Cardiff at their redeveloped home ground, the Laya Arena, after an absence of over two years. Coach Leo Cullen expressed hope that the venue will become a special place for the team to play.

stories.title: Ruins of Gaza's football stadiums
stories.details: Reports have highlighted the destruction of football infrastructure in Gaza. The state of the stadiums serves as a stark reminder of the broader impact of the conflict on sports and community life in the region.

stories.title: US-Iran tensions and oil prices
stories.details: Oil prices have dipped following President Trump's pledge not to attack Iran before the US midterm elections. Despite this, the US military has drafted options for potential future strikes as Houthi militia attacks continue in Riyadh.

stories.title: Andrew Mountbatten-Windsor legal victory
stories.details: A court has ruled that the search warrants used by Thames Valley Police in raids on Andrew Mountbatten-Windsor’s homes were unlawful. The decision marks a significant legal win for the royal.

stories.title: Germany spy chief investigation
stories.details: Retired German spy chief August Hanning has been arrested on suspicion of passing classified information to a foreign agency. Authorities fear he may have provided sensitive details to a high-ranking official in Beijing.

stories.title: Houthi attacks in Riyadh
stories.details: Explosions were reported in the Saudi capital, Riyadh, as Houthi militia in Yemen claimed responsibility for attacks on the city's international airport. The incident has further escalated regional security concerns.
